_template: Verdict form (map v3.6 §3.3). Fill order: claims -> criteria-lock commit -> evidence-manifest -> run -> THIS verdict. This file does NOT validate until placeholders are replaced. Validate: python3 schemas/intake_validate.py <manifest-file> <this-file>. Statuses frozen: PASS | FAIL | INCONCLUSIVE. _-prefixed keys are guidance and ignored by the schema.
_valid_until_comment: a date, or the sentinel 'object-change' if the verdict holds until the verified object changes
verifier: FILL-IN: who confirmed it; if author-verified, SAY SO and state independent-reproduction status

claims._comment: one per verified claim. PASS/FAIL require: verification + evidence (ids from the manifest). FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE require reason_code from: DATA, GRAMMAR, NOISE, DEPTH, ACCESS, BUDGET, ENVIRONMENT, CONFLICT_EVIDENCE, OUT_OF_SCOPE. A reliability claim (kind=reliability) with status=PASS MUST carry 'control' referencing a negative control with N.
claims._kind_comment: optional; 'reliability' switches on the PASS->control requirement
claims.verification: FILL-IN: how it was verified (e.g. V-01: repeated runs N=50)
claims.note: FILL-IN: the decisive numbers in one line

properties_separate._comment: four independent property statements, one line each; they are descriptions, not booleans
properties_separate.integrity: FILL-IN: how artifact integrity is ensured (e.g. sha256 per evidence item)
properties_separate.provenance: FILL-IN: who generated/executed/reported what; AI assistance disclosed where
properties_separate.reproducibility: FILL-IN: what reproduces and what does not; independent replication status
properties_separate.validity: FILL-IN: validity boundary of the method on this object

negative_controls._comment: same controls as in the manifest; claims reference these ids
